author: Retro Game Corps
description:
Lossless Scaling is a handy tool for the Steam Deck and other Linux-friendly handheld PCs. While it's mostly used for PC games, it can unlock some really interesting emulation experiences, too.  This video will guide you through the setup process and showcase some of my favorite games.

Lossless scaling: https://losslessscaling.com/
EmuDeck guide: https://youtu.be/89-LRCob6H8
